title: Nextera DNA Flex NGS Library Prep: Cherrypick Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: 1, A1, A1 1, C5, A2 3, H9, A3 9, E3, B1 ``` Links: * [Cherrypick Samples](./nextera-flex-library-prep-cherrypick-samples) * [Tagment DNA](./nextera-flex-library-prep-tagment-dna) * [Post Tagmentation Cleanup](./nextera-flex-library-prep-post-tag-cleanup) * [Amplify Tagmented DNA](./nextera-flex-library-prep-amplify-tagmented-dna) * [Cleanup Libraries](./nextera-flex-library-prep-cleanup-libraries) --- * Olympus 96-well PCR plates 200ul * [Bio-Rad Hard Shell 96-well low profile PCR plate 200ul #hsp9601](bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) * [P50/P300 Single-channel electronic pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-pipettes) * [300ul Opentrons tipracks](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips) --- Preprogram the thermocycler according to the BLT PCR program parameters described in the kit manual. 4x6 aluminum block tuberack (slot 4, mounted on temperature module) * A1-C
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV for cherrypicking
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file that includes the header line "Source plate (1-9), Source well (A1-H12), Destination well (A1-H12)" and list each transfer (e.g., "1, A1, A1", "1, C5, A2", "3, H9, A3", "9, E3, B1") for up to nine Olympus 96‑well PCR source plates to one Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well destination plate.

steps.title: Gather consumables and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect Olympus 96‑well PCR plates (200 µL), one Bio‑Rad Hard Shell 96‑well low‑profile PCR plate (200 µL, SKU hsp9601), a P50/P300 single‑channel electronic pipette, 300 µL Opentrons tipracks, and a 4 × 6 aluminum block tuberack for the temperature module (slot 4).

steps.title: Preprogram thermocycler
steps.instruction: Program the thermocycler with the BLT PCR program parameters as described in the Nextera DNA Flex kit manual, and mount the 4 × 6 aluminum block tuberack on the temperature module in slot 4.

steps.title: Configure pipette and CSV parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, select the pipette type and mount, load the cherrypicking CSV file, specify the cherrypick volume in µL, and set the starting tip position.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: Use the Opentrons protocol designer to generate the protocol file and download it to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the tiprack, source plates, destination plate, reagent tubes, and temperature module on the deck positions indicated in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate the tiprack, source plates, destination plate, and pipette as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the cherrypicking operation.
